hazards.title: Track loader operating near workers
hazards.description: A compact track loader with a raised bucket is operating in the center-right of the site within a few meters of several workers on foot, with no visible spotter or separation.

hazards.title: Workers near concrete truck chutes
hazards.description: Workers stand between and directly in front of two concrete mixer trucks, beside extended discharge chutes, exposing them to struck-by or caught-between hazards if a truck moves or a chute swings.

hazards.title: Overhead steel work above ground crews
hazards.description: Workers in aerial lifts are working on the steel roof framing while ground crews below work without a visible exclusion zone beneath the elevated work area.

hazards.title: Boom lifts near overhead power lines
hazards.description: Multiple boom lifts are elevated near the steel structure with overhead power lines running across the site in the background, requiring maintained clearance distances.

hazards.title: Protruding conduit stubs and stakes
hazards.description: Numerous vertical conduit stubs, pipes and form stakes protrude from the ground throughout the work area where workers walk, creating trip and impact hazards.

hazards.title: Collapsed and sagging safety fencing
hazards.description: Orange barrier fencing in the foreground and left side is sagging, collapsed and partly lying on the ground, making it an inadequate barricade and a tangle/trip hazard.

hazards.title: Uneven ground and gravel piles
hazards.description: The site surface is rough with loose gravel, soil piles and formwork lumber scattered around the work area, creating uneven footing.

hazards.title: Worker bending while drilling
hazards.description: A worker on the left is bent over at the waist operating a power drill at ground level, an awkward sustained posture.
